stack.backend: FastAPI (Python 3.13), Pydantic v2, SQLAlchemy ORM, Alembic
stack.cache: Redis 7 (rate limiting, permission cache, notification polling)

admin.note: admin actions are themselves audit-logged; admin can create custom roles from the permission registry without redeploy

business_rules.R1_punch_immutability: Employees INSERT-only on punches. Enforced 3x: no edit endpoint, DB trigger blocking UPDATE/DELETE unless session app.role=admin, ORM read-only post-insert. Admin edits require reason and are audited with before/after.
business_rules.R2_dual_timestamps: claimed_at = employee-stated time; server_at = DB clock at insert. Both stored, both shown to MD/Admin, gap highlighted when > 10 minutes.
business_rules.R2b_device_capture: Server derives ip (X-Forwarded-For aware), device_type mobile|tablet|desktop, os_name, os_version, browser from user-agent via ua-parser. Client-sent device fields ignored. Known limit: laptop vs desktop tower indistinguishable; both = desktop.
business_rules.R3_auto_day_marking: Nightly 00:30 IST for yesterday: approved leave->leave; company holiday->holiday; no 'in' punch on working day->absent; else present/half/wfh from work_mode. Idempotent; admin backfill endpoint.
business_rules.R4_mail_on_punch: Every punch inserts mail.outbox row in same DB transaction; worker resolves recipients from admin routing rules at send time; default recipient role:md for punch.in and punch.out. SMTP outage never blocks or loses a punch.
business_rules.R5_eod_lock: EOD editable by author until 23:59 IST of its date, then locked. Admin may still edit (audited).
business_rules.R6_rbac_from_db: Permissions load from auth.role_permissions (Redis-cached 60s, invalidated on edit) so admin-created roles work without deploys. UI gates by permission key, never role name.
business_rules.R7_everything_audited: All writes by all roles including admin -> audit.audit_log (INSERT-only at DB level) with actor, action, entity, before/after JSON.
business_rules.R8_plug_and_play: docker compose up -d from fresh clone yields working app: seeded admin (one-time password printed once), default roles, default EOD template, current-year calendar, demo data when SEED_DEMO=true.
